# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Sailor / Crew member

## Appearance

Pettifer is described as a weather-beaten and hardened sailor. He bears the physical mark of years spent at sea, dressed in typical rugged mariner's attire.

## Personality

Pettifer is loyal to his fellow crewmates and dedicated to his duties aboard ship. He displays resilience in the face of harsh oceanic conditions and sudden danger.

## Traits

- Loyal
- Hardworking

## Abilities

- Seamanship and rigging management

## Goals

- Fulfill his duties onboard and survive the perils of the voyage

## History

Pettifer serves as a member of the ship's crew during the events of the early volumes. He carries out standard nautical duties, assisting in navigating difficult weather and managing the ship's sails. During a crisis at sea, Pettifer falls victim to the hazards of the voyage and dies, marking a sobering loss for his comrades.

## Background by volume

- Served as a capable crewman on sea voyages before meeting a tragic fate
